question: In Windows 10 File Explorer, how can you group files by their type?

options.text: Use the 'Sort by' option and select 'Name'
Rename all files with the same type
Use the 'Group by' option and select 'Type'

solution:
The correct answer is __**Use the 'Group by' option and select 'Type'**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Windows 10 File Explorer, the **'Group by'** option allows you to organize files based on specific attributes such as **Type, Name, Date Modified, etc.**.
 
• To group files by their type, navigate to the **'Group by'** menu and select **'Type'**. Files will then be displayed in categories based on their file extensions.
 
• The **'Group by'** feature is accessible via the **right-click context menu** or the **'View' tab** on the ribbon toolbar of File Explorer.
 
• This feature is particularly useful for organizing and quickly locating files of the same type, such as images, documents, or videos.
 
• After grouping by type, you can further refine the organization by applying the **'Sort by'** option to arrange files within each group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Group by vs. Sort by:**

 
 
• **'Group by'** organizes files into categories based on a selected attribute.
 
• **'Sort by'** arranges files in ascending or descending order within a folder.
 
 
 
• **File Type:**
 
 
• File type refers to the specific format or extension of a file (e.g., .jpg, .pdf, .docx).
 
• Grouping files by type helps users manage multiple formats in a single folder efficiently.
 
 
 
• **Accessing File Explorer Options:**
 
 
• To access the 'Group by' option, open File Explorer, navigate to the folder, and right-click on an empty space.
 
• Alternatively, use the **'View' tab** on the ribbon and select **'Group by'**.
 
 
 
• **Customization:**
 
 
• Users can customize the grouping criteria to other attributes like **Date, Size, Name, or Tags**.
 
• This flexibility ensures that File Explorer adapts to specific organizational needs.
 
 
 
• **Windows File Explorer:**
 
 
• File Explorer is the default file management utility in Windows operating systems.
 
• It provides a user-friendly interface for accessing, organizing, and managing files and folders.
